snapshot.title: Time Jump: 09:00 — Incident Escalation

fields.narration: The clock now reads 09:00. The situation has escalated. The Early Vote Center line has grown to 45 people. The spoofed notice about Polling Location 6 moving back to Carrow Middle School has been shared in 12 local Facebook groups. The hotline has received 137 calls in the past 30 minutes. The IT team has confirmed that the account of Voter Registration Clerk Nina Ruiz was compromised. No formal CIRP level has been declared. Operations are now running in manual mode, using unverified data. The Election Operations Center is still active, but no incident response has been formally activated.
